item.title: Marmota Delivers Wide Bonanza-Grade Gold Intercepts at Greenewood Project
item.description: Marmota hits bonanza-grade gold at Greenewood: 44m @2.3 g/t incl. 4m @16 g/t; open along strike, RC program in March to expand discovery.

item.title: Control Bionics Signs US JV for iOS Speech Devices with NextLevel Assistive Technology
item.description: Control Bionics inks exclusive US JV with NextLevel for iOS speech devices, FDA Manufacturer of Record; aims 1,000–1,500 units/year in a USD 100–150m market.

item.title: ArchTIS Lands US/EU Military Alliance Contract for NC Protect, Secures A$8M Facility
item.description: ArchTIS wins US/EU military alliance contract for NC Protect; up to A$1.22m potential, plus A$8m banking facility to fund US expansion.

item.title: EcoGraf De-Risks Epanko Graphite Project with Updated BFS
item.description: EcoGraf updates Epanko BFS, de-risking Tanzania graphite; Stage 1 US$516m, 73,000 tpa, HFfree purification, Africa’s largest graphite resource.

item.title: TMK Energy Surpasses Production Milestone at Gurvantes XXXV CSG Project
item.description: TMK Energy surpasses 25,000 scfd at Gurvantes XXXV CSG project, led by LF-07, with desorption signs hinting at near-term expansion and funding talks.

item.title: Boss Energy Reports $36.2m Positive Net Cash Flow from Honeymoon Uranium Project
item.description: Boss Energy (ASX: BOE) logs $36.2m positive net cash flow from Honeymoon uranium project; six months to Dec lift in uranium sales, lower C1 costs boost outlook.

item.title: The Calmer Co Finalises $2m Deal for Supply of Kava Ingredients to US Functional Beverage Company
item.description: Calmer Co (ASX: CCO) signs 24-month, $2m/yr kava ingredients deal with US beverage firm; $1.58m minimum. Fuels US expansion and B2B revenue.

item.title: Bioxyne Boosts FY26 Outlook on Strong Performance and International Growth
item.description: Bioxyne lifts FY26 EBITDA guidance to AUD16.5-19m after record H1 FY2026 with AUD31.3m revenue (+149% YoY); expands capacity, enters UK/Germany/LATAM.

item.title: Pure Foods Tasmania Reports 71% Increase in Easter Sales, Signs Initial Supply Deal with Costco
item.description: Pure Foods Tasmania (ASX: PFT) logs a 71% rise in Easter orders, signs Costco supply deal; Coles expansion to 700 stores could lift annual revenue by ~$600k.
